race.description: Allwood Stud Farm 2YOF Westbred Classic Final (G1)
race.comment: Progressive filly NEVELE ARMA (3) made it three wins in a row when she came from this barrier and dug deep last start. Overcame a back row draw to land the Diamond Classic Final prior. Unbeaten at this circuit and distance. Can go close again. SEASIDE SERENADE (2) hit her peak third-up, coming from a wider barrier for a good win at this circuit and distance. In form at the right time and the low draw gives her every chance to deliver again. ILIKEITLIKETHAT (11) was brave after racing wide last start. Had kicked off the campaign with back-to-back wins, one of them from this barrier. Contender. SCANDALEYES (10) draws for a trail and is a first four hope if things go her way.
